svg.title: Part 2: pushing wide boxes up moves a whole tree of boxes
svg.desc: A robot pushing up on a wide box also pushes the two boxes resting above both of its halves. The C code checks the whole tree first and only then moves every box one row up.

g.text: Part 2: wide boxes form a tree when pushed vertically
the C version checks the whole tree first, then moves it
1. robot pushes box [] at row 3 → move_box_top(exec = true)
2. its two target cells hold ] and [ of two different boxes
3. dry run first: move_box_top(.., false) on each — only checks walls
4. all clear → recurse again with exec and swap cells, deepest boxes first
a single wall anywhere in the tree cancels the whole move
